description: Quwi's Chess Patches 1.9.21: a patch of its own finds sf-bridge on your Wi-Fi and fills the computer's address in. Addresses that worked are kept, and a review can look around by itself when the set address stops answering. The sf-bridge firewall command now works on public networks too. Includes the 4.10.18 Home tile fix from 1.9.20 and everything from 1.9.19.

patches.name: AMOLED black
patches.description: Pure black backgrounds instead of chess.com's dark grey, in the newer and the older screens. Switch it in Quwi's Patches (then restart the app).

patches.name: Accent color
patches.description: Your own colour in place of chess.com's green, chosen in Quwi's Patches → Accent color: buttons, highlights, icons and text of the app.

patches.name: Arcade animations
patches.description: Adds the chess.com website's Arcade piece animations to every board: light trails, bursts when a piece is picked up, dropped or captured, a flash on check, outlined last-move squares and animated move hints. Switch it in Quwi's Patches.

patches.name: Arrows in games
patches.description: Adds Arrows and Clear buttons to the game bars (live, daily, archived, pass and play, coach). While Arrows is on, dragging on the board draws an arrow and tapping marks a square, as on the website, and pieces don't move.

patches.name: Arrows in reviews
patches.description: Adds Arrows and Clear to Game Review's bottom bar. While Arrows is on, dragging on the board draws an arrow and tapping marks a square, as on the website, and pieces don't move. Clear joins Arrows while drawing and folds away when it is switched off, so the bar keeps its space.

patches.name: Board colors
patches.description: Choose the board's square colours: your own, or one of chess.com's colour themes, on every board of the app. In Quwi's Patches → Board colors.

patches.name: Clone Chess.com
patches.description: Renames the app to com.chess.noam so it installs next to the real Chess.com app instead of over it. Leave it off to keep updating your current install.

patches.name: Customize Home screen
patches.description: Choose which tiles and sections the Home screen shows, and the order of the tiles. Works on both of chess.com's Home screens (the older list and the redesign).

patches.name: Customize bottom bar
patches.description: Choose the tabs between Home and More (Puzzles, Learn, Watch, Bots, Train) and their order, in Quwi's Patches → Bottom bar.

patches.name: Find the computer on the network
patches.description: Adds Find on the network to the computer review settings: it sweeps the phone's Wi-Fi and fills in the address sf-bridge answers on, keeps the addresses that worked, and lets a review find the computer by itself when the set address no longer answers. In a guest, office or co-working network the devices are often kept apart, and then nothing is found. Needs Game Review on your computer, from this bundle.

patches.name: Game Review on your computer
patches.description: Adds Stockfish on your computer to Game Review: the same review, searched there over Wi-Fi by sf-bridge, much faster than on the phone. The settings have the computer's address and token, its own depth and thread count, a connection test and a benchmark. Selected by default. Needs Unlimited Game Review from this bundle: select both patches, and do not also select Unlimited Game Review from another source - two of them cannot be applied to one app, the second one fails.

patches.name: Global Crash Handler
patches.description: Catches uncaught exceptions and displays a custom crash screen with details to report issues.

patches.name: Great and Brilliant moves analysis
patches.description: Marks chess.com's Great (!) and Brilliant (!!) moves in a review by Local Stockfish or by Stockfish on your computer: the engine's own best move when it was the only one that kept the position good, and a best or nearly best move that offers material for good. It needs the engine's second-best line, so a review asks for two lines at once (MultiPV 2) - no extra time at the same node budget, but the best line ends a ply or two shallower. Selected by default. Needs Unlimited Game Review from this bundle: select both patches, and do not also select Unlimited Game Review from another source - two of them cannot be applied to one app, the second one fails.

patches.name: Hide Premium-only content
patches.description: Free accounts no longer see what only Premium members can use: Premium-only bots are not listed, and the Premium toolbar button, the Home and More banners and the Settings Upgrade row, the Home diamond, the sale banner and More's Membership row are gone. Nothing is unlocked.

patches.name: Lichess Puzzles
patches.description: Puzzles from Lichess becomes the Puzzles tab's big button, with chess.com's Solve Puzzles above it. Lichess's puzzles play in chess.com's own puzzle screen (board, coach, sounds), rated on the phone the way Lichess rates them; nothing is sent to chess.com.

patches.name: Limits as toasts
patches.description: When a free limit is reached (Game Review, puzzles, lessons, drills, videos…) a short toast says so instead of a full-screen Premium offer, and promotional pop-ups are not shown. Nothing is unlocked: the limits stay exactly as they are.

patches.name: No ads
patches.description: Banner, full-screen and game-over ads are not loaded or shown, and neither are their Remove Ads links: the app's own "ads enabled" state and the account's show-ads flag, which are off for members, stay off.

patches.name: No rating prompts
patches.description: The app doesn't ask you to rate it on Google Play. Switch it in Quwi's Patches.

patches.name: Quwi's Patches settings
patches.description: Adds the Quwi's Patches row at the top of the More tab, where the other patches of this bundle are switched on and off. Patches you did not select do not show up there.

patches.name: Stockfish analysis
patches.description: Stockfish 19 on your phone, offline (arm64): best-move arrows on finished games, the analysis boards, the game explorer and Game Review (in a Lichess review, on the moves Lichess didn't mark), and an eval bar where chess.com has none of its own. It never shows while a game is being played or in puzzles. Patching downloads the official Stockfish 19 (80 MB) from Stockfish's GitHub, so it needs internet.

patches.name: Time controls under a minute
patches.description: The custom time slider goes below one minute: 10, 15, 20, 30 and 45 seconds, with or without increment, the way the website allows. Labels read "30 sec" and "0:30+1".

patches.name: Unlimited Game Review
patches.description: Game Review asks who reviews the game: chess.com, Lichess's servers (online, with your Lichess account) or, with the Stockfish analysis patch, Stockfish on your phone (offline, no daily limit). The phone and Lichess judge moves the Lichess way (?! inaccuracies, ? mistakes, ?? blunders, accuracy and centipawn loss) in chess.com's own review screen, and the phone marks the moves Lichess leaves unmarked Best, Excellent or Good, as chess.com does. Finished games only; a live game on screen is never analysed. Two more patches in this bundle add Stockfish on your computer and Great (!) and Brilliant (!!) marks. Select Unlimited Game Review from this bundle only: a second one from another source cannot be applied to the same app.

patches.name: Unlimited Play Coach
patches.description: Removes the one-free-game-per-day limit on Play Coach, a bot-only practice mode.

patches.name: Unlock Premium content
patches.description: The app's own premium-tier check always answers with the top tier, so content gated on it (lessons, drills, insights, themes, puzzle-rush extras and anything else that reads the account's tier) treats the account as a member. The server still decides what you may actually play online.

patches.name: Unlock all bots
patches.description: Every bot in Versus Bots can be played, including ones only Premium members may play.

release_notes:
Stable build.

- A patch of its own, Find the computer on the network, adds a Find on the network row to the bridge settings: it sweeps your Wi-Fi on the bridge's port and fills in the address sf-bridge answers on. It needs Game Review on your computer, from this bundle.
- An address a review connected through is kept, newest first, and a review tries the set address and then the saved ones before giving up.
- Find the computer automatically, on by default: when no address answers, a review sweeps the Wi-Fi once and searches where it found the bridge.
- The sf-bridge firewall command now allows the port on public networks too (profile=any remoteip=localsubnet), since Windows ignores a private-only rule on a cafe, office or co-working network.
- Includes the 4.10.18 Home tile fix from 1.9.20 and everything from 1.9.19.
repoDescription: A fork of Noam's Morphe Patches for chess.com: Game Review on the Stockfish of your own computer, plus Great (!) and Brilliant (!!) moves.
